_comment: deploy/github_posture.json — the DOCUMENTED GitHub-side control posture (#1320, epic #1355).
This file is the machine-readable mirror of what the docs claim; deploy/drift_sentinel.py's
check_github_config()/check_github_push_runs() GET-assert live GitHub state against it weekly.
RULES: (1) every entry carries a `source` naming the doc that makes the claim — this file
declares the documented posture, never a wish; (2) a PR that amends the claiming docs (e.g.
the #1319 approval-gate fork) MUST flip the matching entry in the same PR, or the sentinel
will honestly report the divergence every Monday; (3) never run black on this file (JSON);
(4) #3207 — an entry that is DECLARED but DELIBERATELY NOT YET APPLIED carries `applied:
false` plus `blocked_on` (the human-readable blocker) and `ledger_row` (a substring that
identifies its row in docs/MANAGED_WHERE_LEDGER.md). The sentinel then reports that surface
as `pending` — a state distinct from drift — and recommends satisfying the blocker, NEVER
`apply_branch_protection.py --apply`. The applier refuses `--apply` on an `applied: false`
entry for the same reason. When the blocker is satisfied and the change is applied, flip
`applied` to true in the SAME PR: the sentinel reports a live-applied surface still marked
`applied: false` as DRIFT (a stale marker), so the marker cannot rot into a false green.
tests/test_posture_pending_marker.py pins the marker <-> ledger agreement.

environment_production.name: production
environment_production.source: ADR-065 ('CI's production approval gate stays intact') + CLAUDE.md CI/CD section + ci-cd.yml ('requires manual approval via GitHub Environment: production'). RESOLVED 2026-07-20: the gate is LIVE again (required_reviewers, 1 reviewer) — restored after the public flip made env protection available; the 2026-07-13 private flip had silently dropped it (#1319, closed VERIFIED-DONE). A future private flip drops it AGAIN — see project_repo_visibility memory for the flip-back checklist.

main_ruleset.source: docs/CONVENTIONS.md drift-discovery table + docs/MANAGED_WHERE_LEDGER.md (#1325): exactly main-block-force-push-and-deletion, rules [deletion, non_fast_forward] only, enforcement active, no pull_request/required_status_checks rule.

main_required_checks_ruleset.name: main-required-fast-lane
main_required_checks_ruleset.blocked_on: RECONCILE_PUSH_TOKEN (A-Grade Program D0.6, #3042) — the fine-grained PAT ci-cd.yml's reconcile job must push with to match the `User` bypass actor below. Applying this ruleset before that secret exists wedges the post-merge reconcile push on EVERY merge (#3207): the job falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN, which authenticates as github-actions[bot] and is not covered by a `User` bypass.

bypass_actors.why: #2198, measured 2026-08-07 under BOTH the session auth and the owner's own gh auth: an `Integration` bypass actor for the github-actions app 422s on this repo — 'Actor GitHub Actions integration must be part of the ruleset source or owner organization' — because this repo is owned by a personal (User) account, not an organization the app is installed into. GitHub's ruleset schema documents `User` as a separate, valid actor_type (distinct from the org-only `OrganizationAdmin`), and the repo owner trivially satisfies 'part of the ruleset source'. A `User` bypass only matches a push AUTHENTICATED as that account, so ci-cd.yml's `reconcile` job pushes with the `RECONCILE_PUSH_TOKEN` repo secret (a fine-grained PAT owned by this account, Contents:read-and-write on this repo only) instead of the default GITHUB_TOKEN — GITHUB_TOKEN authenticates as the github-actions[bot] Integration identity, which this bypass does not cover. Sequencing matters: `--apply` must not run until that secret exists (see `reconcile_push_secret_provisioned` preflight in scripts/apply_branch_protection.py) or the very next reconcile push is rejected with no bypass to catch it.

required_status_checks.why: ADR-139's fast lane: pytest --collect-only (the #1297 class), the deploy_critical marker subset (ADR-117), and black --check over the six enforced dirs. Measured 1m26s on PR #2094. `on: pull_request: branches: [main]` with NO path filter and no job-level `if:` — it reports on every PR class including docs-only.

required_status_checks.context: gitleaks (PR commit range only, not full history)
required_status_checks.why: #1659 credential-pattern scan, scoped to the PR's own commit range. Measured 9s on PR #2094 (the run that also confirmed the trigger analysis live). `on: pull_request: branches: [main]` with NO path filter and no job-level `if:` — it reports on every PR class.

advisory_not_required: CodeQL analysis (python) / (javascript-typescript) — codeql.yml is unfiltered on PRs but its `analyze` step never exits non-zero on a finding, so requiring it buys latency and no verdict (ADR-148).
Dependabot Validate / validate — job-level `if:` restricts it to dependabot[bot] dev-tooling branches, so it reports `skipped` on every human PR; a skipped required check never satisfies the rule.

Wiki drift gates (docs-ci.yml), Surface-drift gate (surface-drift.yml), Migration coverage + HTML well-formedness / Render + accuracy gate (v4-gate.yml) — all PATH-FILTERED, so they simply do not report on PRs outside their globs and would block those PRs forever.
Unit Tests / Lint + Syntax Check (ci-cd.yml) and Visual + AI-vision QA — post-merge (push/scheduled) only; they emit no PR check-run to require.
main_required_checks_ruleset.source: ADR-148 (branch protection: fast-lane required checks + auto-merge, #1662, epic #1648) + docs/CONVENTIONS.md drift-discovery table + docs/MANAGED_WHERE_LEDGER.md. Applied by scripts/apply_branch_protection.py --apply (driver-run, post-merge). It has NOT been applied — see `applied`/`blocked_on` above; until the blocker is satisfied the sentinel reports this surface as `pending`, not drift (#3207, rule (4) above).

repo_settings.blocked_on: RECONCILE_PUSH_TOKEN (A-Grade Program D0.6, #3042) — auto-merge is only useful once the fast-lane required checks exist, so it flips in the SAME `--apply` as main_required_checks_ruleset and inherits the same blocker (#3207).
repo_settings.source: ADR-148 (#1662): auto-merge is the mechanism that makes fast-lane required checks cost zero wall-clock — the operator arms the merge once and GitHub lands it when the required checks go green. Applied by scripts/apply_branch_protection.py --apply.

vulnerability_alerts.source: ci-cd.yml pip-audit advisory step ('Dependabot will open a bump PR for the affected package') + ADR-082 (Dependabot is the CVE remediation channel). RESOLVED 2026-07-20: alerts ENABLED live (owner toggle after the public flip; SDLC finding P2-4 closed).

push_run_detector.source: #1544: six consecutive squash merges to main (2026-07-19 16:17-19:20 UTC) produced ZERO push-event workflow runs — not red, ABSENT. A trigger-matching merge with no queued run within grace_minutes is the alarm condition. #1782 (2026-07-26): the historical-gap cluster threshold was removed — non-head commits of a multi-commit push have no run of their own by GitHub design, so a count of uncovered older commits is reported, never alarmed; only a push HEAD with no run past grace_minutes drifts.
